### Day 51: 2 Samuel 8:1–18
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-51-2-samuel-8-118.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 8:1-18
Points:
- David actively engaged on the battlefield to cooperate with God's promises rather than passively waiting.
- David showed mercy by preserving a remnant of Moab rather than annihilating them.
- David gave all credit to the Lord, dedicating the captured silver, gold, and bronze directly to God.
- David governed with justice and equity, reflecting the character and kingdom of God.
- David demonstrated administrative wisdom by delegating key governmental responsibilities to trusted leaders.
